name: SEA Wire and Cable, Inc.
description: SEA is the largest stocking distributor of Isodyne. We have a tremendous and broad availability of parts as well as the purchasing power to provide you with the best market cost possible. Isodyne’s connector backshell Tool-less Braid Termination System was specifically designed to provide better mechanical and electrical performance for wire harnesses requiring shielding protection for EMI/RFI, HIRF, and lightning. Both the individual shields and the overbraid are terminated at the backshell with one band. Our spring band can be installed and removed thousands of times with no tools allowing for easy re-entry of the cable assembly for repair or re-pinning and no degradation of spring force. The Isodyne backshell system has been in use since 1990 on land, sea, air, and space platforms requiring a higher performance connector backshell.
